goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

plan.title: ETH vs BTC Underperformance Analysis - Fresh ETH-Optimized EMA Trend Gate
plan.objective: Determine if ETH underperformance vs BTC (0.489 vs 0.998 Sharpe) is due to BTC-optimized parameters overfitting, or genuine regime/structural differences by running fresh optimization on ETH
plan.hypothesis: If ETH with fresh optimization achieves Sharpe > 0.7, then previous underperformance was due to BTC-parameter overfitting. If ETH remains below 0.5 Sharpe even with fresh optimization, the underperformance is due to regime/structural differences between BTC and ETH
plan.strategy_rationale: EMA Trend Gate strategy was previously tested on ETH using BTC-optimized parameters (0.489 Sharpe). Running fresh optimization on ETH will reveal whether the gap is due to parameter overfitting or market regime differences. This follows the same strategy to ensure comparability while varying the optimization target.
dataset_requirements: ETH/USDT 1h OHLCV data from Binance, minimum 2 years for robust WFA

historical_depth_requirement.justification: ETH has deep Binance history similar to BTC. Multi-year history required for robust WFA with 85+ windows. Market policy requires multi-year when realistically available.

source_plan.selection_reason: Existing deep ETH data at workspace/data/binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv. Same source as prior BTC/ETH experiments for comparability.

plan.scope_selection_rationale: ETHUSDT is the natural follow-up to the prior BTC run (RUN-20260331154310-1aowi1) which achieved 0.998 Sharpe. Using same strategy type (EMA Trend Gate multi-timeframe) enables direct comparison of whether underperformance is due to overfitting (BTC params on ETH) or regime differences (even ETH-optimized underperforms).

data_acquisition.reason: Existing ETH data at workspace/data/binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv. Verify coverage before execution.

inputs: Reference: RUN-20260403123500-01 (ETH with BTC params, 0.489 Sharpe)
Config: Similar to BTC run wfa_config
implementation_steps: 1. Verify ETH data coverage (timestamp range, row count)
2. Create WFA config for ETH-optimized EMA Trend Gate (fresh optimization, not using BTC params)
3. Execute WFA with Optuna optimization on ETH data only
4. Compare resulting Sharpe to BTC baseline (0.998) and ETH-with-BTC-params (0.489)
5. Analyze if improvement from fresh optimization indicates overfitting, or if gap persists indicating regime differences

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA must complete with valid OOS metrics. Compare Sharpe to BTC baseline (0.998) and ETH-with-BTC-params (0.489).

fallback_if_blocked: If ETH data insufficient, fall back to BNB/USDT as alternative altcoin for cross-asset generalization test
If WFA fails on ETH, run on SOL/USDT to test if underperformance is general to altcoins vs BTC
notes: Key comparison: Fresh ETH optimization should improve over BTC-params-on-ETH (0.489). If reaches > 0.7, indicates overfitting. If stays < 0.5, indicates regime difference.
This directly addresses the backlog question: regime differences vs overfitting on BTC
Same strategy, fresh optimization = controlled experiment for parameter overfitting

relevant_execution_lessons.lesson: BNB is the worst-performing asset in EMA Trend Gate series
relevant_execution_lessons.specific_finding: BNB achieved 0.432 OOS Sharpe vs SOL 1.373 (+218%), BTC 0.998 (+131%), ETH 0.489 (+13%). Exchange token utility-driven demand creates distinct volatility regime that reduces strategy effectiveness.
